description: METROPOLIS –State Representative Patrick Windhorst (R-Metropolis) says he’s running for re-election. The Metropolis Republican has built a strong conservative voting record since taking office in 2019, amassing a 100% pro-life and 100% pro-2nd Amendment record. Windhorst has advocated for policies to reduce Illinois’ excessive taxes, burdensome regulations, and high cost of living. Windhorst has risen through the ranks of House Republican leadership to be selected House Republican Floor Leader,

title: HOUSE GOP FLOOR LEADER STATE REP. PATRICK WINDHORST ANNOUNCES RE-ELECTION CAMPAIGN
